description: Returns the current page automation state, including URL, title, ready/loading/failed/crashed status, HITL pause status, and blocking dialogs or file choosers.

pageId.description: Page ID whose current state should be synchronized.

purpose.description: Describe why you need the current state, e.g., checking whether a page is ready, verifying no blocking dialog, or resuming after HITL
